gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathological evidence of newly diagnosed glioblastoma according to WHO classification criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: Radiofrequency electromagnetic field treatment using a carrier frequency of 13.56 MHz

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Pathological evidence of newly diagnosed glioblastoma according to WHO classification criteria

role_evidence.quote: followed by RCT (60 Gy over six weeks) with concomitant CT (temozolomide 75mg/m2) on all days, followed by maintenance CT (temozolomide150-200 mg/m2) on d1-5 for six cycles every 28 days.

source_quote.quote: MGMT-promotor methylated patients must have refused therapy according to the CeTeG/NOA-09 protocol (+ Lomustin)

coder_notes: Device trial (radiofrequency hyperthermia) added to Stupp chemoradiation; the only registered intervention is a device, so no pharmacological candidate. Temozolomide is named as received by every patient (Stupp) and listed as backbone. MGMT criterion is a conditional eligibility restriction (methylated patients only if they refused lomustine regimen), coded eligibility; not an entry requirement for a particular MGMT status in a strict sense. Lomustine is only mentioned in this criterion, not listed.
